tools.name: transfer_domain

tools.name: create_cart

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the StableDomains.net agent directory (approved AI agents and MCP servers) by keyword or capability. Returns name, description, url, endpoint_url, mcp_url, capabilities, payment_methods and profile_url.

tools.description: Get one agent directory profile by slug.

tools.description: Agent profiles you submitted (any status: pending, approved, rejected) with review notes. Submit a new one with POST /api/v1/agents (auth required, moderated).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "radar_alert" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Save a Drop Radar search and get a signed webhook (event radar.match, header X-StableDomains-Signature = sha256 HMAC of the body with the returned secret) and/o…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: radar_alert, dns_email_check, watch_domain, search_agents, list_my_agent · Private data: radar_alert, get_dns, set_dns, set_auto_renew, get_renewal_balance · Public sink: pay_order, radar_alert, dns_email_check, watch_domain, set_notification_webhook, list_my_agent · Destructive: find_dropping_domains, drop_radar, radar_alert, is_domain_dropping, set_notification_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: radar_alert, dns_email_check, watch_domain, search_agents, list_my_agent · Private data: radar_alert, get_dns, set_dns, set_auto_renew, get_renewal_balance · Public sink: pay_order, radar_alert, dns_email_check, watch_domain, set_notification_webhook, list_my_agent · Destructive: find_dropping_domains, drop_radar, radar_alert, is_domain_dropping, set_notification_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
